Front Cover: All Hybrid Subjects 

The front cover of all subjects’ booklets 
has the same information. Before testing 
begins, proctors will direct students to 
complete the necessary information.

For all hybrid exam subjects, if a student 
realizes they’ve star
 
ted writing on  
the wrong  page, they can cross out their 
 
work and write on the corr
 
ect page.

For regular and late testing, the exam 
date will be printed above the exam title. 
Students and proctors should ensure they 
have the correct exam materials.

Students fill in identifying information on 
the left side and read the information on 
the right side. 

Students write the school code, which they 
can copy from their AP ID label sheet.

The duration of the exam section and 
number of questions students need to 

answer in the booklet are listed. 

Either a pencil or pen is permitted for 

all hybrid subjects.

Students put an AP ID label in the box 

at the bottom.
